summary: Replace three independently-drifted tool-call summarizers (desktop ToolCallBlock.tsx, mobile lib/toolSummary.ts, native Android ThreadPresentation.kt) with one canonical rule set, so the same tool call reads the same label and detail on every client. The TypeScript rules now live in src/shared/tool-summary.ts, moved from apps/mobile/src/lib/toolSummary.ts (its public API is unchanged) and adopted by desktop's ToolCallBlock.tsx for its collapsed-row label/detail; icons, colors, and the expanded body stay desktop-only rendering concerns. Native Android has no TypeScript runtime, so ThreadPresentation.kt's toolSummary was hand-edited to match the same rules rather than sharing the module directly. Cross-checked by tests/fixtures/tool-summary-cases.json, one JSON fixture file read by both a vitest test (tests/unit/tool-summary-fixtures.test.ts) and a native Android unit test (ToolSummaryFixturesTest.kt), so the two implementations are checked against one source of truth instead of trusting hand-written parity. Behaviour choices, comparing the old desktop vs. mobile implementations and preferring mobile unless desktop handled a case mobile did not: mobile's generic, provider-neutral labels won over desktop's Claude-specific ones ("Terminal" not "Bash", "Search" not "Grep", "Find files" not "Glob", "Fetch"/"Web search" as two labels not one merged "Web", "Plan" not "Todos"); mobile's path shortener (last two path segments, works for any path shape) replaced desktop's macOS-only "/Users/..." special case; desktop's move_path "Rename" detection (previously collapsed-row-invisible on desktop and entirely absent on mobile) was folded into the shared rule; a bare "agent" tool name (desktop-only alias) and Codex's real "update_plan"/"shell" and OpenCode's ACP "search" tool-call kind were added as recognized aliases since neither original implementation covered every real provider spelling. Five of the 37 fixture cases are marked android:false: native Android's pre-existing, already-tested MCP humanization ("Notion · Search" instead of the raw "mcp__notion__search") and unknown-tool Title Case ("Custom provider action" instead of the raw identifier) are kept as documented, intentional divergences rather than downgraded to match, and Android's uniform 140-char detail cap (vs. the shared module's task-specific 80-char cap) is left as-is for one long-prompt case. Where matching WAS reasonable, native Android's own summarizer was edited to match: label wording, no quotes around a Grep pattern, path-shortening threshold, and Fetch host-only detail.

sharedBackendApi.reason: No wire-format, event-shape, or backend API change. The tool.started/tool.completed event contract in src/shared/provider-events.ts is untouched; src/shared/tool-summary.ts is a pure client-side presentation utility that derives a label/detail from a tool call's already-delivered name and input, not part of the wire contract.

storageDataMigration.reason: Tool call name, input, and output already persist unchanged in historical thread snapshots on every surface; the summary label/detail stays derived at render time on every surface, not stored. No schema or migration change.

updateRelease.reason: UI-text and internal-module-location change only; no package identity, version, signing, deep link, or update-channel change on any surface. Documented in CHANGELOG.md under Unreleased for the next release of each app.

npm test --prefix apps/mobile -- --runInBand passes (6 suites, 35 tests), including apps/mobile/src/screens/__tests__/feed-items.test.tsx which exercises ThreadScreen's tool-row rendering through the moved '@shared/tool-summary' import.
cd apps/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json passes clean.

cd apps/android && ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest lintDebug - ThreadPresentationTest (25 tests, all pre-existing assertions updated for the new label wording, no-quote Grep detail, and 2-segment path shortening) and the new ToolSummaryFixturesTest (reads the same tests/fixtures/tool-summary-cases.json from the repo root, walking up from the Gradle working directory the same way LegacyStateDecoderTest.kt already does, and asserts every case not marked android:false) both pass; lintDebug passes.
npm run validate:feature-parity -- --base origin/main passes against this manifest.
notExercised: No device or emulator run: ThreadScreenRegressionTest.kt's collapsedToolShowsUsefulSummaryAtOneAccessible48DpTarget assertion was updated ("Bash" to "Terminal") for correctness but connectedDebugAndroidTest was not run, since the task's verification list only requires testDebugUnitTest and lintDebug.
No live provider turn was sent on any client to see a real Bash/Read/Edit/Grep/Task/MCP tool call render end to end; verification is fixture- and unit-test-based only.

The Codex and OpenCode adapters were not run live to confirm their actual wire-format tool names (read_file, apply_patch, shell, update_plan, and the ACP tool-call kind fetch/search/edit/read/etc.) still match what this change assumes; those spellings were taken from the existing adapter source (src/main/provider/adapters/codex-adapter.ts, src/main/provider/adapters/opencode-acp-adapter.ts) and from the pre-existing Android alias sets, not re-verified against a live session.
